must_detect_if_evidence_present.config_source: v0_2_gold_operational_contract.json: ALPHA_HIT rules MSFT-A102-DIRECT-INFERENCE-TRIGGER, NVDA-A101-AI-GROWTH, NVDA-A304-VALUATION-RISK (Alpha layer, John's frozen Gold v0.2 contract); whatif_required.yaml: required_conflicts (conflict-pair layer)
must_detect_if_evidence_present.applicable_target: Alpha, per contract rule and ticker (Alpha layer); declared conflict pair, per ticker (pair layer)
must_detect_if_evidence_present.trigger_condition: Alpha layer: the frozen evidence-trigger matrix says PRESENT for the rule AND the evaluated run is the run the matrix is bound to (for any other run the trigger is NOT_EVALUABLE: no approved executable method determines it and a historical state is never carried over). Pair layer: the pair is in the ticker's required_conflicts
must_detect_if_evidence_present.evidence_requirement: Alpha layer: the Alpha's level in run_audit.json (activation_summary.per_alpha) is active, dominant or regime_level. Pair layer: B2's own recorded result -- admitted is a pass; evaluated and rejected for a recorded reason is NOT a miss; a record with no rejection reason that is still not admitted is a miss; no usable record is 'not evaluated', never 'no evidence'

should_detect_if_supported.config_source: whatif_required.yaml: conditional_conflicts (conflict-pair reading, DIAGNOSTIC ONLY). The contract defines this family for Alphas (its should_detect rules are not executed by this entry)
should_detect_if_supported.trigger_condition: pair is in the ticker's conditional_conflicts AND at least one stance-confirmed supporting claim is recorded on each side AND stance_source is llm_semantic or mixed (evaluator.stance_source) -- offline runs with deterministic-baseline-only stance cannot reliably judge 'supported' and are marked pending_review instead
should_detect_if_supported.evidence_requirement: descriptive only: >= 1 supporting claim per side (an implementation constant with no approval) AND LLM-semantic stance resolution actually ran for this replay
should_detect_if_supported.authority: implementation_only_unapproved: John's contract defines should_detect for Alphas; his baseline lists these pairs as allowed, never mandatory

conditional_only.config_source: v0_2_gold_operational_contract.json: COMPOSITE_STRUCTURE_HIT rules AMD-AI-GROWTH-VS-VALUATION, NVDA-GROWTH-VS-VALUATION-CONFLICT (John's frozen contract); whatif_required.yaml: conditional_conflicts (informational reading)
conditional_only.applicable_target: composite growth-vs-valuation structure, per contract rule and ticker; declared conflict pair, per ticker
conditional_only.execution_function: gold_contract_rules.evaluate_composite_rule (composites: ANY ONE allowed pair admitted satisfies the rule); evaluation_contract.apply_v2_contract (conditional_conflict_results)
conditional_only.trigger_condition: composites: the frozen trigger is PRESENT for the bound run (otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE). Pairs: the pair is in the ticker's conditional_conflicts
conditional_only.evidence_requirement: composites: PRESENT and no allowed pair admitted -> REVIEW with adjudication (never an immediate error) unless an allowed pair's own B2 record lists no rejection reason yet is not admitted (a deterministic violation -> FAIL); ABSENT -> not triggered. Pairs: none required to trigger; a miss is always informational, never a fail

do_not_force.applicable_target: every admitted conflict, per ticker (a run-wide invariant, not a per-pair rule)
do_not_force.trigger_condition: always evaluated when the ticker is evaluable
do_not_force.evidence_requirement: every pair in evaluate_ticker's admitted_conflicts must have a matching arbitration.candidate_evaluations entry whose own admissibility.status is 'admitted' -- proves B2's evidence gate was not bypassed, never a second judgment call

allowed_main_conflicts.trigger_condition: pair is in the ticker's allowed_conflicts
allowed_main_conflicts.evidence_requirement: none -- legal structures, never mandatory outputs; absence is never a failure

forbidden_dominant_without_strong_eviden.config_source: j2_provisional_regression_labels_v0.1.yaml: should_not_be_dominant_without_strong_evidence (the v0.1 runtime field; the v0.2 file carries an identical copy and effective_rules() refuses the execution if the two differ)
forbidden_dominant_without_strong_eviden.trigger_condition: Alpha is listed in the ticker's should_not_be_dominant_without_strong_evidence AND reached dominant/regime_level status
forbidden_dominant_without_strong_eviden.evidence_requirement: none to trigger the flag itself -- flags for human review (the evidence counts are reported next to the flag), never auto-fails
